275187583.description: This lot contains approximately 5.2 pounds of mixed collectible minerals, crystals, and gemstones. The assortment includes polished and raw stones such as agate, quartz points, amethyst, calcite, obsidian, and possibly jasper and tiger's eye. There are shaped pieces including a carved heart, star, crescent moon, spheres, and eggs. Additional items include a geode, fossilized shark tooth, and a mini snowball specimen from Cataloochee. The collection features both tumbled and rough stones with a variety of colors and finishes. The items are in good used condition with minor handling wear. Suitable for collectors, crafters, or educational use.

275069894.description:
Handcrafted Gemstone Tree
Amethyst Chips and Gold-Tone Wire
Natural Amethyst Cluster Base
This decorative "Tree of Life" sculpture features an array of tumbled amethyst gemstone chips meticulously wired to form a delicate canopy. The structure is supported by a hand-twisted gold-tone wire trunk that originates from a substantial raw amethyst geode base, creating a harmonious blend of natural mineral specimens and artistic craft. Such pieces are often utilized in Feng Shui practices to promote positive energy and tranquility within a space.
Tumbled amethyst gemstone chip "leaves" securely attached with twisted wire
Hand-formed wire trunk and branches in a bright gold-tone finish
Natural amethyst cluster base featuring distinct crystalline points and matrix
Protective felt padding on the underside to prevent surface scratching
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The wire structure is flexible and can be adjusted as desired. Amethyst chips are intact and retain their characteristic purple hue. The crystal base shows natural variations and inclusions typical of raw mineral specimens. No structural damage or significant wear is present.
